messages:
alex: quick follow-up on the model stamp ownership proposal i dropped earlier — i want to nail who is the "authoritative" owner in metadata and what their responsibilities are

maria: tl;dr: owner should be a service principal (team/app) not an individual, otherwise we get churn and stale pins

devon: +1 on principal. also we need a clear handoff procedure when an owner leaves or a model is promoted

ryan: suggestion: metadata fields: owner, owner_type (team|service), created_by, origin (hosted|dedicated|private), stamp_hash, seq_epoch, lease_until

alex: that set looks good. question: should owner be mutable by default? what about delegated operators for emergency unpin?

maria: immutable for normal ops, mutable via a documented handoff API that requires two-step approval (owner + infra or long-lived service token). emergency unpin should be gated and logged

samira: for private deployments we also need an "authority" flag to indicate local override vs control-plane canonical. otherwise rollout semantics diverge

devon: propose semantics: authority=control|local; control authoritative by default for hosted/dedicated; local allowed for private where customer opts in. include provenance chain in metadata for traceability

alex: related: TTL vs lease_until. TTL is relative; lease_until is absolute epoch. prefer lease_until in metadata + optional ttl for quick UIs

ryan: agree. implementation note: runtime will evict when now > lease_until unless a refresh call renews lease (owner-authenticated)

maria: also want a soft_tombstone flag: soft_tombstone=true allows clients to gradually migrate and runtime to prefer fallback, but preserves observability for rollback windows

samira: how do we expose this in the pinning API? call patterns I imagine: POST /pins {model, stamp_hash, owner, lease_until, authority, soft_tombstone, hints: []}

alex: API shape looks fine. add required field "immutable_until" for critical pins where we block owner mutation for a safety window (e.g., compliance freeze)

devon: we should limit mutable operations to owners and a small ops-role; record audit_event with reason and identity on every mutation. retention for audit logs >= 1 year for enterprise customers

ryan: on the wire: keep metadata compact. use short keys for runtime: o, ot, cb, orig, sh, e, l, a, st, iu, h  (we can map these in control-plane UI to long names)

maria: i hate short keys but i get perf. let's document mapping and version schema in rollout-manifest v1. include schema_version tag in every pin record

alex: decision summary so far (for RFC follow-up): owner is service principal, authority flag for control vs local, lease_until absolute, optional ttl, soft_tombstone semantics, immutable_until support, two-step handoff API, audit events required, schema_version on records. i'll draft the follow-up RFC with example payloads and a migration plan for existing pins

samira: one more ops consideration: signal for automatic rebind/fallback. add an optional fallback_stamp field (compatible variant) so smart routing can cutover without owner intervention

devon: action items: alex will draft RFC; maria to write migration checklist and vet with security; ryan will prototype compact wire encoding; samira will validate private deploy override flow with partner infra

alex: thanks team. i'll post the draft RFC monday and tag everyone for review. :thumbsup: 

sre-bot: deploy-bot: noted. RFC draft scheduled and notifications queued for @architecture next_monday 09:00 PST
